designationHistory.indexText: Congress established the Detroit River International Wildlife Refuge along 18 miles of the lower Detroit River.

authority.citation: Detroit River International Wildlife Refuge Establishment Act, Public Law 107-91, 115 Stat. 894

designationHistory.note: Boundary expanded by Public Law 108-23 (May 19, 2003) into Ohio (CCP).

sources.name: U.S. Fish and Wildlife Service, Detroit River IWR Comprehensive Conservation Plan, 2005 (ServCat 43600)
